items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Baby Downs was there for a while. I think he had a stroke at that time. And he wasn't too active.

ctx.x: You said Baby Downs was in New York.
Baby Downs was there for a while. I think he had a stroke at that time. And he wasn't too active.
I'm trying to think. Was Simeon around at that time? Did he start to play at Ryan's?
